title: A tool call should always round-trip through my code?
text: Someone assumes a tool call always comes back through their own code. Wrong guess. Sometimes it does, sometimes it doesn't. Why web search never runs your code, but your own tool always does.

title: Same declaration, different behavior
text: Declaring a tool feels uniform. You list it, Claude can call it, so every call should behave the same way afterward.
